label: Resistance from dimensions
subgoals: Read width and length from the fractured geometry
Take thickness and resistivity from the layer stack
Evaluate resistivity times length over width times thickness

label: Vias in series and in parallel
section: Vias in series and in parallel
subgoals: Divide a cut's resistance by the number of parallel cuts
Count every via level crossed going up and coming down
Sum wire and via resistances along the current path

label: When vias dominate
subgoals: Total the wire resistance and the via resistance separately
Express the via share as a percentage of the total
Weigh layer changes against wirelength in routing cost
